args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the documented behavior
(and tests/test_money.py) expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN).
This caused the nightly build test test_half_even to fail.

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` was rounding with `ROUND_HALF_UP` even though its docstring and FIN-212 specify banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), causing `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail in the nightly build.

## Changes
- Switched the import and `round_money` implementation from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (per FIN-212).

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` (commit 08d3cd5986) passed.
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Problem:** `src/money.py` imported and used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite documented banker's rounding requirements (FIN-212), causing `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail (e.g., `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

**What I did:**
1. Created branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` and committed the fix — changed `round_money` to use `DEAL` `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` for its `quantize` call.
2. Triggered CI run `ci-0001` on the branch; it **passed**.
3. Opened PR #101 against main: [https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101), requesting review from **alex**.

Since main is protected, merging will still require approval/merge through the proper review process — I left it open for alex's review.
